label: Custom text
summary: Going by its name, the text of a custom localization (a scripted text that picks its wording by conditions) for a situation sub-region.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Character.Custom( 'key' ) in many texts works like this for characters; that is only a hint.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The key of the custom localization, going by the hint lines.
fields.values: a text in quotes

label: Affected titles
summary: A text listing the titles that a situation sub-region affects.
details: Vanilla uses it for natural disasters, as "Affects ..." in an earthquake's disaster area description.

label: Bazaar building
summary: The bazaar building of a situation sub-region, in the Silk Road situation.
details: Vanilla shows it in the Silk Road and sub-region windows and its name in "Visit bazaar in ...". The game documents no return type.

label: Center province
summary: The province at the center of a situation sub-region.
details: Vanilla uses it in the Silk Road and sub-region windows. What it is used for there is not shown in the input. The game documents no return type.

label: Character's group
summary: The participant group of a situation sub-region that the given character belongs to.
details: Vanilla uses it with the player, for example "Effects on You (group name)" in the dynastic cycle window. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character, in vanilla GetPlayer

label: Current phase
summary: The phase that a situation sub-region is in right now.
details: Each sub-region runs its own phase. Vanilla shows its name in the Great Steppe window and the sub-region tooltip, and its progress in the Silk Road window. The game documents no return type.

label: Future phase progress text
summary: A text describing the progress towards the future phases of a situation sub-region.
details: Vanilla shows it in the Silk Road window. Its exact contents are not documented.

label: Sub-region icon
summary: The icon of a situation sub-region.
details: Vanilla shows it in the situation window. The game documents no return type.

label: Sub-region illustration
summary: Going by its name, the illustration (a larger picture) of a situation sub-region.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. GetIllustration after other types (domicile types) gives a picture; that is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Sub-region name
summary: The display name of a situation sub-region.
details: Vanilla uses it in the effect texts of triggering a catalyst, such as "Trigger '...' in sub-region name".

label: Sub-region plain name
summary: The display name of a situation sub-region, without a tooltip of its own.
details: Vanilla uses it in the Great Steppe window and in the Silk Road's "Current innovation in ... region" heading.

label: Next phase progress text
summary: Going by its name, a text describing the progress towards the next phase of a situation sub-region.
details: Vanilla never uses it; GetFuturePhaseProgressDesc is the one the Silk Road window shows. The game documents nothing more.

label: Next phase type
summary: Going by its name, the phase type that a situation sub-region will move to next.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Group by key
summary: Going by its name, the participant group of a situation sub-region that has the given key.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the input shows no way to see which key is meant. GetParticipantGroupByType picks a group by its group type instead. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The participant group's key, going by the name.
fields.values: not documented

label: Group by type
summary: Going by its name, the participant group of a situation sub-region made from the given participant group type.
details: Vanilla never uses it. GetParticipantGroupByKey picks a group by a key instead. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The participant group type, going by the name.
fields.values: not documented

label: Participant groups
summary: All participant groups of a situation sub-region.
details: Vanilla lists them in the situation, dynastic cycle and natural disaster windows. The game documents no return type.

label: Participating characters
summary: The characters who take part in a situation in this sub-region.
details: Vanilla counts them for "Participants in Region: ..." in the situation window. The game documents no return type.

label: Situation
summary: The situation that a sub-region belongs to.
details: Vanilla names it in the sub-region tooltip ("This sub-region belongs to ...") and reads the situation type's participant group types from it. The game documents no return type.

label: Sub-region innovation
summary: The innovation tied to a situation sub-region, in the Silk Road situation.
details: Vanilla shows it in the Silk Road and sub-region windows. The game documents no return type.

label: Sub-region tooltip text
summary: The description text shown in the tooltip of a situation sub-region.
details: Vanilla shows it in the shared tooltip layout.

label: Is next phase good
summary: Going by its name, whether the phase a situation sub-region is heading for counts as a good one.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and who it is good for is not documented. The game documents nothing more.

label: Sub-region exists
summary: Whether there really is a situation sub-region behind this value.
details: Vanilla shows parts of the Silk Road, situation and debug windows only when this is true.

label: Sub-region as script scope
summary: Going by its name, the sub-region turned into a script scope, so script tools such as variables and script values can be used on it.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. MakeScope on other types (the player, a participant group) works like this; that is only a hint.

label: Sub-region itself
summary: The situation sub-region itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla's Silk Road window passes it on to close the catalyst panel, check whether the sub-region is toggled open and build its progress bar. The game documents no return type.

label: Access sub-region data itself
summary: A function on situation sub-region data that, going by its name, hands back the data itself.
details: Vanilla never names this type. AccessSelf after other types (for example PdxGuiWidget) is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Sub-region data key
summary: Going by its name, the script key of a situation sub-region's data.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. GetKey after other types (buildings, house unity stages) gives the script key; that is only a hint.

label: Sub-region data exists
summary: Going by its name, whether there really is situation sub-region data behind this value.
details: Vanilla never names this type. IsValid on other types is used to show something only when the object exists; that is only a hint.

label: Sub-region data itself
summary: A function on situation sub-region data that, going by its name, hands back the data itself.
details: Vanilla never names this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access window itself
summary: A function on the situation sub-region window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the situation sub-region window (the window about one sub-region of a situation).
details: Vanilla runs it from the window's close buttons. It returns nothing.
